messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I don’t have access to live‑time databases right now, so I can’t give you an official “current” world ranking from the ATP or WTA tours.  

**What’s publicly known (as of my latest update)**  
| Tour | Last confirmed #1 (late 2024) |
|------|------------------------------|
| **ATP (men’s singles)** | *Novak Djokovic* – he held the No. 1 spot through most of 2024, though his position has fluctuated since then. |
| **WTA (women’s singles)** | *Iga Świątek* – she topped the list at the end of 2024 and remained near the summit into 2025. |

If you’re looking for the exact rank today (e.g., after the 2026 Australian Open), you’ll want to check:

* [Official ATP Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/players/player-rankings)
* [Official WTA Rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings)

Those sites refresh weekly and will show who holds the top spot at this very moment.
